notes:
Summary: Lodestar builds a ticket-deflection layer for mid-sized SaaS customers; primary goal is deflecting top-volume tickets with a RAG pipeline that returns a top-5 list for quick answer and suggested KB articles. Key constraints: tight latency SLOs (p95 end-to-end target <300ms), scaling to ~120 QPS peak for e-commerce peak times, index size currently ~6-10M docs (expect 30M within 12 months). Customer plan: embed at ingest, store vectors in their existing vector DB (evaluating Pinecone vs Weaviate), then run a lightweight GPU reranker to boost top-5 quality (nDCG@5 target >=0.75, top-5 precision target >=0.85).

Engineering notes / asks: prefer Dedicated or Private deployment so reranker can live on same cluster as retrieval to avoid network hop causing extra 40-80ms latency. Want batching + prefix caching recommendations from Redwood Optimize to keep per-query cost < $0.02 (goal $0.004-$0.018 depending on query complexity). Concerned about indexing cost/time: need guidance on bulk ingest throughput and warm-up strategy for embedding compute. Also need guidance on concurrency limits when exploiting KV cache for sessionized agent workflows.

POC details: Lodestar provided 6M doc snapshot; Redwood SE ran baseline with hosted embeddings + remote vector DB + GPU reranker on separate infra — results show good relevance but fails latency objective at p95. Preliminary bench: co-located reranker on Dedicated reduced p95 from 480ms -> ~260ms and improved CPU cost per query. Customer quote from 11/19: "If we can't hit p95 <300ms, product managers will push back on deploying deflection in the live agent flow." Security: requires SSO (SAML), KMS integration, audit logs, and data residency for EU customers.
